what_happened: Two separate data stores for learnings existed: top-level ~/.sovereign/learnings/ (2 entries from Feb 7, legacy) and ~/.sovereign/chronicle/learnings/ (27 entries, active). check_mistakes reads from chronicle/learnings correctly, but the legacy directory creates confusion during audits. The legacy store was created before the chronicle was restructured and never cleaned up.
what_learned: When refactoring data store paths, delete or clearly mark the old location. Orphaned data directories that look active but arent create false leads during debugging. A future instance seeing ~/.sovereign/learnings/ with 2 entries might think thats all the learnings that exist, missing the 27 in chronicle/learnings/. Name collisions across directory depths are silent traps.
